name: aplyca
description: Aplyca's agentic development tooling — the Agentic Development Framework's plugins: adf for the process, adf-dev for development, and adf-connect for trackers and services

plugins.name: adf
plugins.description: The Agentic Development Framework for Claude Code: /adopt and /upgrade install and maintain it in a repository, committed or packaged; /cost-report measures what agent sessions cost. A packaged project also takes the framework's skills, agents, workflows, and guardrail hooks from this plugin, pinned to a release.

plugins.name: adf-connect
plugins.description: The Agentic Development Framework's connections plugin: /adf-connect:connect connects a project to its tracker or a stack service — Supabase, Vercel, Contentful, GitLab, Linear, Jira — through the service's official MCP server, with safe defaults and only its read tools pre-approved.

plugins.name: adf-dev
plugins.description: The Agentic Development Framework's development plugin: skills and agents for building, running, and checking the code, each from an optional module — /adf-dev:dev-env sets up, diagnoses, and safely resets a Docker Compose local environment (the docker module). Turn it on in a packaged project with one of its modules; elsewhere its skills stop.
